title: ChestTrackerPro
description:
ChestTrackerPro lets players track, name, and remotely access chests via a custom GUI.
Supports commands to add, remove, and rename chests with saved data and permission-based limits.
body: **ChestTrackerPro** is a lightweight and user-friendly chest management plugin that allows players to track, name, and remotely access their chests through an intuitive GUI. With support for adding, removing, and renaming tracked chests, as well as permission-based tracking limits, it's perfect for survival, economy, or RPG servers looking to enhance inventory organization and player convenience.
